summary: Reproduced negative-only CFG Spectrum initialization and cross-request forecaster reuse on the prepared main checkout. Implemented branch-local generation-start reset for models with separate CFG state while preserving positive-only reset ownership for shared-counter models. Added regressions for negative-only initialization, stale forecaster removal, serial dual-branch synchronization, and the shared-counter boundary.

tests.what_was_measured: On the prepared base, the first negative step used window 0.0 instead of 2.0 and the next request reused the prior negative forecaster. Raw output: reports/j-bde897918c6b/raw/reproduction_before.txt
10 focused Spectrum tests passed, including four lifecycle regression and boundary cases. Raw output: reports/j-bde897918c6b/raw/test_spectrum_after.txt
The first negative step used the configured 2.0 window and the next request did not reuse the prior forecaster. Raw output: reports/j-bde897918c6b/raw/reproduction_after.txt

On AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950, GPU prediction matched CPU with max absolute difference 2.288818359375e-05 and analytic reference relative L2 1.1933200767089147e-05. Raw output: reports/j-bde897918c6b/raw/gpu_numerical.txt
Patch whitespace integrity. Ruff was unavailable in the prepared interpreter and is recorded separately in reports/j-bde897918c6b/raw/format_check.txt.

gpu_execution.evidence: A deterministic Spectrum forecaster CPU-vs-GPU numerical comparison ran on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X with gcnArchName gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-. This was component-level validation, not full model or multi-rank reproduction.

remaining_limitations: No Wan model weights were provided, so full diffusion generation and semantic output accuracy were not tested.
No multi-rank CFG-parallel model run was performed; the reported lifecycle was reproduced deterministically through the actual Spectrum implementation.
Ruff was not installed in the prepared Python environment; git diff --check passed.
